notes: Oliver's official Australia site says whole-menu nutrition is available online through Prepit and updated in real time.
Prepit pages publish per-serving calories, protein, serving size, ingredients, and allergen disclaimers for Oliver's menu items.
No static Oliver's nutrition PDF was found; use the Prepit links as the official current nutrition source referenced by Oliver's.
Calories and protein are copied from Prepit's per-serving rows. Do not recalculate from kJ unless a future source omits calories.

Vegetarian status is based on Oliver's product descriptions where they say vegan friendly, plus Prepit ingredient checks for no meat or fish. The page metadata has traps: some meat items were observed with a Vegetarian tag, so tags alone are not trusted.
Prepit warns values are average figures based on standard formulations; serving sizes and nutrients may vary by preparation, region, season, supplier changes, and cross-contact.
Keep variants separate. Gluten-free bun swaps, sauce changes, breakfast-only items, kids meals, bowls, pockets, and sides have different serving sizes and macros.
Add-ons are included only where official Prepit macro rows exist and the item is a plausible side or extra, not a low-protein condiment.
